title: Once Poisoned, Arbitrarily Controlled: A Programmable Backdoor in VLMs
abstract: Existing vision-language model (VLM) backdoors are usually treated as static vulnerabilities: one-to-one and N-to-N attacks bind one or more triggers to a finite set of targets before victim training. title: SafeCap: Improving LVLM Safety with Image Captioning Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that exploit visual inputs to bypass safety alignment inherited from their language backbones.
